about: Incorporated in 1999, Waaree Renewables Technologies Ltd is engaged in the business of generation of power through renewable energy sources and also provides consultancy services in this regard. [1] Waaree Energy is one of the largest vertically integrated new energy companies. It has India's largest Solar panel manufacturing capacity of 12GW at its plants in Chikhli, Surat and Umbergaon in Gujarat.
